---
name: safety-oracle
description: Portable compiler safety checks.
engine: 0.2.0-lab.1
roles: [requester, assistant]
---
contract @infinity => expired
type question
 f0: text(100000, regex: ~r/a*/)
 f1: text(100000, regex: ~r/a*/)
 f2: text(100000, regex: ~r/a*/)
state new
 requester -> assistant: question() => complete
end complete
